title: Singapore student left home saying she was going to college; hours later her family found her...
summary_full: A Singaporean student, Siti Aishah Siregar, disappeared after telling her family she was going to college. Her family discovered her passport missing and a flight ticket to Cambodia in her email. Singapore police confirmed the 20-year-old had already departed the country on an outbound flight. Her father issued an emotional appeal on Facebook for assistance to locate his daughter.
